heading: INT. DECOMMISSIONED LIGHTHOUSE - LAMP ROOM - DAY

units.text: INT. DECOMMISSIONED LIGHTHOUSE - LAMP ROOM - DAY
Salt-fogged glass wraps the room in a cold white glare.
Six folding chairs have been arranged in a circle around the great Fresnel lens, as though the lens itself were the facilitator.
A flip chart reads, in bubbly marker: "SYNERGY IS A VERB."
PRISCILLA OKONKWO-HALE (50s, silk scarf, lanyard worn like a medal) stands beside the flip chart with a laser pointer.
GREGOR "GIGGLES" LINDQVIST (40s, never once seen laughing) slumps in the nearest chair.
MARISOL TREJO (30s, spreadsheet-pale) clutches a gluten-free muffin.
BARNABY FIELD (60s, tie knotted for a funeral) reads the safety placard on the wall.
DEEPA RAMANATHAN (30s, sharp, phone face-down on her knee) watches the door.
HOLLIS PYM (20s, intern, sunburned already) hugs a box of markers.
Okay, team. Check-in. One word for how you're showing up today. Gregor, let's start with you.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Present.
units.name: GIGGLES

units.text: That's not a feeling, Giggles.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: It's the only one I'm contractually obliged to have.
units.name: GIGGLES

units.text: Priscilla, the ferry doesn't come back until six. Is that right? Because the booking said "overnight optional."
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Marisol, the beauty of an island is that we're all optional together.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Priscilla, with respect, the placard says the gallery railing is rated for four persons. We are six, plus the lens.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Barnaby, the lens doesn't count as a person.
units.name: DEEPA

units.text: Deepa, it has more seniority than Hollis.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: That's fair, Barnaby. Honestly, that's fair.
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: Hollis, sweetheart, I need you to stay in your lane and also grow.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Which lane is that, Priscilla?
units.name: HOLLIS

units.text: The one with the markers.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Giggles, did you read the pre-work? Because I read the pre-work, and the pre-work said we'd be "dismantling silos," and I don't see a single silo, I see a lighthouse.
units.name: DEEPA

units.text: Deepa, a lighthouse is just a silo with ambitions.
units.name: GIGGLES

units.text: Giggles, that's the nicest thing you've said all quarter.
units.name: MARISOL

units.text: Marisol, it wasn't nice. It was accurate.
units.name: GIGGLES

units.text: Everyone, eyes up. Barnaby, put the placard down. Deepa, phone. Marisol, muffin. Hollis, marker. Giggles, whatever that is, stop.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Priscilla, I would like it noted that I have been with this company for thirty-one years and have never once been asked to hold a marker.
units.name: BARNABY

units.text: Noted, Barnaby. Noted and parked.
units.name: PRISCILLA

units.text: Parked where? There's no parking. It's an island.
units.name: DEEPA
